spans.s:
रित् रित्, त्, त्, त् (fr. rt. 1. रि), Ved. (per-
haps) moving, flowing, (Sāy. = गन्तृ.)

रितक्वन् रितक्वन्, आ, m., Ved. a thief,
(various reading for तक्वन्, Naigh.

रीति, इस्, f. going, motion, moving, flowing, trick-
ling; a stream, river; a course; a line, streak; a
limit, boundary (= सीमन्); general course or way,
method, mode, manner, fashion; usage, observance,
custom, practice, natural property or disposition;
style, diction, (three styles of diction or composition
are enumerated, viz. वैदर्भी, गौडी, पाञ्चालि, to
which a fourth is sometimes added, viz. लाटिका, and
even a fifth and sixth, viz. आवन्तिका and मागधी);
bell-metal, brass, pale brass; calx of brass; rust of
iron; scoria of any metal or the oxide formed on
the surface of metals by their exposure to heat and
air.
—रीति-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with estab-
lished usages or customs.
—रीति-पुष्प, अम्, n.
‘brass-efflorescence,’ calx of brass.
—रीति-प्रष्ठ,
अस्, अम्, m. n. a Praṣṭha weight of brass.
—रीति-
बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, brass-bound, studded or inlaid
with brass.
—रीती-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a row,
standing in a line.
—रीत्य्-अप्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. stream-
ing with rain.

रीतिक, अम्, n. calx of brass; (आ), f. bell-metal,
brass.
